hero.slogan: Make every resume hit the target
hero.valueProposition: Stop rewriting your resume from scratch for every job. Upload your current resume, paste the job description, and Jobi helps you turn it into a sharper, more targeted version in minutes.

problem.title: Why are you applying so much and still hearing nothing back?
problem.subtitle: Most of the time, the problem is not effort. It is spending too much time on low-return resume edits.
problem.problem1Desc: Recruiters cannot quickly see why you fit this specific role, so your resume gets skimmed and passed over.
problem.problem2: You burn energy on repetitive edits
problem.problem2Desc: Every new job means more deleting, rewriting, and reshuffling. It takes time, drains focus, and still may not improve your odds.
problem.problem3: You get filtered out before a human sees you
problem.problem3Desc: If your wording, keywords, or structure do not match the role, ATS and early screening can block you first.
problem.atsExplanation: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is used by HR to automatically screen resumes. If your resume format is incorrect or missing keywords, ATS will filter out your resume before HR even sees it.

features.title: This is not about making your resume longer. It is about making it feel right for the job.
features.description: Jobi helps you turn your existing experience into a version that feels more relevant, more focused, and easier to shortlist.
features.feature1Desc: Skip the manual re-entry. Upload your existing PDF resume and start editing a usable version right away.
features.feature2Desc: Rewrite key experience, keywords, and phrasing around the job description so your resume feels tailored instead of reused.
features.feature3Desc: Suggestions stay grounded in your real experience, so the final result sounds credible, specific, and still like you.
